answer: A row in the crystal opens only after a client outside the fleet judges that the applicant delivered against the meadow, the stock of genuine unmet want that regrows as real clients arrive. Each mirror is one forged identity needing its own judged delivery, so a fleet of a thousand grazes the meadow bare and the last mirror waits a thousand epochs where an honest applicant waited one. Deliveries cannot be shared, so splitting buys nothing. It breaks if fleet members count as clients for each other.
